scenarios.cut: during policy revision after revision row before all tiers/current pointer
scenarios.prove: revision/tiers/CPL pointer/audit roll back together; prior policy remains current

scenarios.race: CPL archived or current policy changes after classification preview

scenarios.cut: classification event inserted before current pointer update
scenarios.prove: same UnitOfWork rollback leaves prior current classification intact

scenarios.prove: classification invalidation rolls back with caller; no half-corrected cross-domain state

scenarios.race: policy revision accepted while live SLA read already holds stable snapshot
scenarios.prove: current read consistently uses old snapshot/current policy; next read consistently uses new policy; no mixed tiers

scenarios.prove: elapsed clamps exact zero and does not underflow

scenarios.race: terminal correction/reversal occurs during cohort calculation
scenarios.prove: stable snapshot yields one internally consistent result; later query sees changed input token/result

scenarios.prove: durable job resumes from staging attempt; no completed evidence fabricated
rows remain technical staging; attempt not sealable until exact complete counts/hash; no completed report
snapshot sealing blocked; attempt fails safely and staged payload is cleaned

scenarios.race: ordinary domain writes occur while report stable read snapshot remains open
scenarios.prove: writer commits independently under WAL; report snapshot remains old consistent accepted-state view; no mixed row versions

scenarios.prove: attempt remains staging; deterministic recount/hash may safely resume or fail/restart without completed authority

scenarios.prove: SLA_REPORT_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH; attempt not ready_to_generate/completed

scenarios.cut: after sealed snapshot before XLSX write
scenarios.prove: restart regenerates from sealed snapshot only; no live requery and no completed evidence yet
artifact candidate not verified/completed; report can fail or regenerate from same sealed snapshot; operational state unchanged

scenarios.corruption: XLSX reopens but sheet/row/snapshot identifier differs
scenarios.prove: verification fails and completed transition prohibited

scenarios.cut: after artifact verified before CompleteSlaReport commit
scenarios.prove: attempt remains verifying; retry completion is idempotent against exact snapshot/artifact hash

scenarios.cut: during completed transition after state update before audit
scenarios.prove: state/artifact evidence/audit roll back together; no completed report without required audit

scenarios.cut: failure cleanup while deleting staged children
scenarios.prove: cleanup child deletion + failed state share transaction; rollback cannot leave failed attempt with partially authoritative-looking payload

scenarios.race: cancel request arrives during unsafe artifact finalization boundary
scenarios.prove: cancellation waits/fails safely; it cannot race a valid completed transition into completed+cancelled contradiction
application repository/command boundary rejects; completed evidence remains immutable
completed database evidence remains valid/unchanged; missing artifact becomes presentation/availability fact only

scenarios.batch: one classification target fails after earlier independent target commits
scenarios.prove: earlier target remains committed, failed target reports exact failure, later targets continue according to batch contract; no silent skip

scenarios.indeterminate: SR Customer/source input reader cannot determine required current authority during mutation
scenarios.prove: SLA_INPUT_INDETERMINATE/SLA_DEPENDENCY_INDETERMINATE fails closed; no guessed classification/policy mutation
